items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The helper `_filter_prefetch_queryset` has clear names (`predicate`, `low_mark`, `high_mark`, `window`) and is formatted like the surrounding code. It has few comments, but the same is true of the reference.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: A shared helper is added to related_descriptors.py, but contenttypes/fields.py copies the same Window/RowNumber/GreaterThan/LessThanOrEqual/clear_limits block inline instead of reusing it. That is duplicated logic in two places.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: `db = queryset._db or DEFAULT_DB_ALIAS` followed by `queryset.using(db)` forces every unsliced prefetch onto 'default' and skips the database router. This regression fails test_using_is_honored_fkey, test_using_is_honored_m2m and test_using_is_honored_custom_qs.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: Uses `Window(RowNumber(), partition_by=field_name, order_by=...)` with `GreaterThan(window, low_mark)`, and adds `LessThanOrEqual` only when high_mark is not None. Calls `clear_limits()` on the queryset copy made inside get_prefetch_queryset. The slice is computed per parent in SQL, and all 4 F2P tests pass.
